About Geeta Communication

Happy Customer Our Goal !

We started Geeta Communication Mobile Shop in 2005 near Ram Mandir, Sardarshahar. Today we are serving you from the basement of Three Star Complex, Krishna (Private) Bus Stand, Sardarshahar.

It is our privilege and good fortune to have this platform to connect with you. This was made possible by the hard work of two brothers, Shri Shiv Bhagwan Pandia and Shri Bajrang Lal Pandia, who supported us then and continue to do so today. ~ Indar Pareek & Pawan Pareek (Owners)
